annotations.title: Chart the rental yields of developments or areas

description: Use this instead of get_rental_yield when the user asks to chart, plot or graph the rental yields of up to 4 Singapore developments, HDB streets or towns, or postal districts, such as "Chart the rental yields of Treasure at Tampines and District 18". Takes the same subjects as get_rental_yield and draws each size band's gross yield as a bar, with the sales and rentals behind it, each subject linked to the Homejourney page that shows the same yields. A band with fewer than 5 sales or 5 rentals has no bar and names its shortfall. Also returns the same yields, counts and page links as text, so quote them and cite the pages when the host cannot show the chart.
name: render_rental_yield_chart
title: Chart the rental yields of developments or areas
